The spec is written, with 5 capabilities (CAP-1 to CAP-5) and one companion. I did not run any code, and the repo still has none. The notch counts in the examples were checked by hand against a 22-grade scale. The REQ-06-02 example in the POC document contradicts that scale, so I logged it as an open question. It is not a passing test yet.
